demonstrates: Measured whether one model can hold several separately trained compartments: the naive limit is two, a companioned training recipe moved four-compartment retention from negative to positive, a diverse companion pool became the recipe of record, and a scale ladder showed the eight-compartment penalty is a mid-depth valley; every artifact the sweep's own controls caught is reported alongside.
